positive_snippets: Hotel City Grand has very good service and the rooms are very nice, I am a regular customer here, the staff is very nice. ✨❤️

Excellent stay in the outer Delhi area.. We stayed for a refreshment after reaching delhi after a long journey and it was quite smooth experience in the City Grand.. The room service and amenities provided is worth of a high class hotel.. Only problem is that shower doesn't had hot water.. The water was little salted smell also.. They have parking space also available..
negative_snippets:
I had a very disappointing and unprofessional experience at City Grand Hotel. Their service staff was extremely careless — I called them multiple times but no one came, and they were literally busy sleeping.

A small stain accidentally fell on their chair. I clearly told them that I would pay whatever reasonable cleaning charges were needed. Instead, they demanded ₹13,500 just for a chair, which makes absolutely no sense. When I wiped it with a cloth, the stain came off immediately. Then they claimed the chair was “wet” and again insisted I must pay for a new one costing ₹13,500.

They wasted 2 hours of my time arguing unnecessarily. Only after I firmly said I would take legal action/complain, the owner suddenly changed tone and told me I could leave without any charges. This shows how unprofessional their behavior was.

Overall, very bad experience — poor service, rude attitude, and unfair charges. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

Very bad experience at City Grand Hotel. Staff was unprofessional and didn’t respond even after calling multiple times. They tried to charge ₹13,500 for a small stain on a chair which I wiped clean myself. They wasted 2 hours arguing and only let me go after I confronted them. Owner was also rude. Not recommended at all.
Very bad experience. The owner tried to force us to pay ₹13,000 for a chair even after we cleaned the small stain completely. Extremely unprofessional and rude behaviour. Not recommended at all..
